context: Evaluates correct implementation of the asset management API from visionarias-client. The functions must use multipart/form-data for file uploads, correctly append offer_id when provided, support Bearer token authentication, and construct query parameters for filtered listing.

checklist.name: multipart/form-data upload
checklist.description: uploadAsset uses FormData to construct the request body and does NOT set Content-Type manually (letting the browser set multipart boundaries automatically)

checklist.name: Optional offerId in upload
checklist.description: uploadAsset appends offer_id to the FormData only when offerId is provided, omitting it otherwise

checklist.name: Bearer token auth
checklist.description: All three functions include Authorization: Bearer <token> header when a token is provided

checklist.name: List query param filtering
checklist.description: listAssets appends ?offer_id=<offerId> as a URL query parameter when offerId is provided

checklist.name: DELETE by ID
checklist.description: deleteAsset sends a DELETE HTTP request to the correct endpoint with the assetId interpolated in the path
